description: Source code for the Payroll Entry doctype in ERPNext, handling payroll processing, salary slip creation, validation, and related operations.

classes.name: PayrollEntry
classes.description: Main class representing a payroll entry, handling payroll processing, salary slip management, and accounting entries.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Checks if salary slips were manually submitted when loading the document.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the payroll entry, primarily counting employees.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Triggers creation of salary slips upon submission.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Validates employee attendance before submitting payroll.

methods.name: validate_employee_details
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate salary slips exist for employees in the period.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Deletes associated salary slips when payroll entry is canceled.

methods.name: get_emp_list
methods.description: Returns list of active employees matching criteria and with salary structure.

methods.name: make_filters
methods.description: Creates filter dictionary based on payroll entry fields.

methods.name: fill_employee_details
methods.description: Populates employee list based on criteria, with validation.

methods.name: check_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures mandatory fields are set.

methods.name: create_salary_slips
methods.description: Creates salary slips for selected employees, enqueuing if many.

methods.name: get_sal_slip_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of salary slips based on status and criteria.

methods.name: submit_salary_slips
methods.description: Submits salary slips, enqueuing if many, and creates accounting entries.

methods.name: email_salary_slip
methods.description: Emails salary slips to employees if configured.

methods.name: get_salary_component_account
methods.description: Fetches account linked to a salary component.

methods.name: get_salary_components
methods.description: Retrieves salary components of a specific type from salary slips.

methods.name: get_salary_component_total
methods.description: Calculates total amount for salary components of a type.

methods.name: get_account
methods.description: Maps salary components to accounts and totals amounts.

methods.name: make_accrual_jv_entry
methods.description: Creates journal entry for salary accruals.

methods.name: update_accounting_dimensions
methods.description: Adds accounting dimension info to journal entry rows.

methods.name: get_amount_and_exchange_rate_for_journal_entry
methods.description: Calculates exchange rate and amount for journal entries.

methods.name: make_payment_entry
methods.description: Creates payment journal entry for salary payments.

methods.name: create_journal_entry
methods.description: Creates a journal entry for salary payment or accrual.

methods.name: update_salary_slip_status
methods.description: Updates salary slips with journal entry reference.

methods.name: set_start_end_dates
methods.description: Sets start and end dates based on payroll frequency.

methods.name: validate_employee_attendance
methods.description: Checks if employees have marked attendance for the period.

methods.name: get_count_holidays_of_employee
methods.description: Counts holidays for an employee within a period.

methods.name: get_count_employee_attendance
methods.description: Counts attendance days for an employee within a period.
